verdict.rationale: Chargebee exposes a full REST API with API-key auth (no interactive login required), form-encoded/JSON I/O, idempotency keys for safe retries, official SDKs (e.g., Node.js), and async export jobs polled via API — all of which support scripting the product headlessly in CI/automation pipelines. However, there is no explicit CI/CD guidance, CLI tool, or documented automation/testing workflow (e.g., GitHub Action, Docker image) confirming CI usage patterns. Missing for 10: explicit CI/headless usage documentation or tooling, a CLI, and independent confirmation of running Chargebee calls inside a CI pipeline.
